paraphrased_obligations: Internal class names use slash-separated unqualified name segments.
A segment is nonempty and excludes period, semicolon, left square bracket, and slash.
Parentheses and spaces do not appear in that exclusion list; they are permitted for internal class-name segments.
The method parameter-unit budget includes the implicit receiver for instance/interface invocation.
scope: Grammar and parameter-unit context only; no additional nominal class hierarchy rule.
